reviews_h2: What people say after we are done

reviews.author: Anita Surrett
reviews.text: Thank goodness, for good people. We broke down on our way to Charleston on a holiday weekend, with our 40 ft camper on tow. They went out of their way to stay open late and get us back on the road the same day. Great job done quick and willingly! Thank you Carolina Auto Repair for saving our vacation!

reviews.author: Jessica Harvey
reviews.text: The owner was amazing! He was quick and I was very happy with how much it cost to fix my vehicle. I will recommend this shop to all friends and family.

reviews.author: mike blades
reviews.text: Wow all I can wow, you guys are the best, fixed my truck in 2 hours and had me back on the road again. will definitely bring my truck back when it needs repairs. thanks.

reviews.author: Sebrena Muirhead
reviews.text: I have a 1984 Chevette this shop neat, organized an clean .They don't have a overload of cars just sitting around taking up space. This company been also working on my classic car since 2019. I live in Augusta this shop is 11 miles away it's worth going to them just had a starter put in my vehicle 7 Fed 25. Car ready for pickup 10 Fed 25 never been overpriced at all excellent customer service from the dispatcher and the young lady in the office thanks again for your help.

reviews.author: CLAYTON LEWIS
reviews.text: I highly recommend this repair shop! I took my Chevy S10 in with several issues going on. Problems were quickly diagnosed and communicated with me promptly. Frequent updates(with photos of damaged parts) were sent via text to me. It took only a couple of days to get me back on the road. Pricing was very fair considering the repairs that were needed. I've known the owners for a long time, and I trust them with my automotive repair needs. Give them a try!

reviews.author: Sabrina Perrone
reviews.text: I can see why they have such good reviews. They were able to take my truck in the same day I called. Fixed it in a day and at a reasonable price. I will definitely be using them in the future if needed and recommending them to anyone I know who has car issues !

reviews.author: Doug H
reviews.text: I didn't have a big job, but they got me in right away did exactly what they said they were going to do and the price was better than fair. I recommend these guys.

reviews.author: Jessica Simmons
reviews.text: My van unfortunately needed repair but thankfully I contacted Carolina Auto Repair! They were completely amazing with all aspects of service. Not only was the issue diagnosed quickly, but the repair was done the next day! They were also very helpful with helping me get where I needed to be. Thank you so much! 10/10 recommend.

reviews.author: Trudy Benitez
reviews.text: This place was great. I didn’t know any mechanics in the area and was so glad I picked them. They towed my car and had it fixed right away. They were quick to pick up. Their price was very reasonable for all the work they did. Would definitely use them for all my auto repairs. They were professional and very friendly and easy to work with. Thank you so much for your great service! You guys are the best.

reviews.author: Sarah Bailey
reviews.text: They fixed my power steering & AC issues for almost $1200 less than Fairway Ford in Evans was trying to charge me. My car works great now! The guys there were so nice & didn't try to trick me and into work that I didn't need. I'll definitely be going back to them when I need work done again!

reviews.author: James Laminack
reviews.text: I was totally impressed by their honesty and courteous service. Mine was a simple fix, but hard to pin point. They could have sold me an expensive part when it was a simple fix that took a service rep to find and fix with just a wrench. They made themselves a new customer. I go back where I am treated right and they were excellent! Service with a hand shake and a smile. The good old fashioned way, the right way!

reviews.author: Amy Shealy
reviews.text: I recently retired from teaching in Georgia and moved back to North Augusta when I noticed a lot of water in the floorboard of the driver’s side of my Jeep. I took it by a couple of different repairs shops. No one wanted to bother with it. A couple of weeks ago, I started my Jeep to leave one morning and the windshield wipers were on and wouldn’t turn off. My Jeep wouldn’t go in gear. I decided to go on line to find a local repair shop that would work on Jeep. That’s how I came across Carolina Auto Repair. I gave them a call and John told me to bring it in. I went. I told John all the problems I have had recently with my Jeep especially with the water. He listened and asked me to leave the Jeep with them for a few days to see if they could resolve these problems, especially with the water. Problems Solved!!! I am very satisfied with the courtesy, professionalism, and determination that Carolina Auto Repair showed me. The cost was extremely reasonable. John and Bill both went out of their way to make sure I was taken care of. They genuinely care about their customers. I would highly recommend Carolina Auto Repair. Carolina Auto Repair will get all my auto business from now on. Thank you John and Bill!

reviews.author: Robert Chase
reviews.text: Had a conflicted experience at Carolina Auto Repair. I was in the middle of a 6 hour drive and my check engine light came on and Carolina was the closest shop from where I stopped. The technician did a very quick job getting my airflow system fixed up and ready to go. I spent 500 dollars. I'm giving three star rating however due to the fact that I had to return to the shop the next day (during my return 6 hour drive) to fix the same problem again that apparently wasn't picked up on the first time. During which I was told that it would be one price (50 dollars), which I would just have to pay for the part and not the labor since my car issue wasn't fixed the first time around for the same issue. What was frustrating is that regardless of that, they had started service without my confirmation. The second service was equally quick and the issue was eventually fixed, but the agreed upon price was changed after the fact adding in labor (equaling out to 100 dollars). All told I spent more money then I was originally told as a result of a confusion of information between the owners. I paid without argument, but it was incredibly frustrating to be told one price and then see 50 dollars added on later for no complication reason AFTER the work had been done. It was the labor, which I get. You have to pay your guys. The work was good and the people there are great, and I would have paid the bill I ended up paying because of those positive factors. But if you offer me one number and then change it, after already having to return multiple times for a single issue? Even after I had already paid 500 dollars? It feels very sketchy. Hopefully my experience wasn't the norm.

reviews.author: Keith Aiken
reviews.text: Carolina Auto Repair is the BEST Auto Repair shop I have ever experienced! Frank and his team work above and beyond to get any job completed. No matter how small or big the job, I was satisfied! I have gone to this establishment for a restoration on a 75 Impala and to get standard work done on all my vehicles. I know I am going to get the most fair price and top notch service. I would recommend Carolina Auto to anyone that is looking for a wonderful and professional experience for their vehicle needs!!!

reviews.author: Rez
reviews.text: Great place to get your car repaired! John and Frank were extremely helpful and even provided me a ride to the shop when my car was done. Repairs only took a few hours and the price was low for what I was getting done. Go no where else to get your car fixed. They are awesome!

reviews.author: Grover Babbitt
reviews.text: These are genuine, honest people who really did an unbelievable job with my Civic. I was traveling , and almost all of the people I asked for an honest auto repair business said this was the place to go. Unfortunately, it was towed to another place. The difference in repair was $429, so I explained my situation and the management promised way less expensive repair. They even gave me free towing Their price versus the other place was actually more than $429 because of the unexpected discount I received. This was a true blessing because my wife and i are retired and victims of Hurricane. My Honda Civic is running so smooth and when I told them I was late for an Animal Rescue Seminar , the owner Mr Mishoe , not only made my vehicle a priority but gave me a 15 percent discount for my work with animals, and gave me a pocket Bible. This is the 1st business that I have seen that is not afraid to show their Christian values. God Bless Him and his entire family! I may live in North Carolina , but Carolina Auto Repair will be worth the drive. I thank them so very much, and hope Mr Mishie sees this as a small token of appreciation. - Dr Grover Babbitt

reviews.author: Luis Zavala
reviews.text: When my vehicle broke down on I-20, I knew it was something serious. Being new to the CSRA, I really didn't know where to turn. While I waited for a ride I looked up shops in the area. I came across Carolina Auto Repair, and spent some time reading reviews. John and has team have 5 stars for a reason. I trusted my gut instinct and called them up. They quickly got my car towed into the shop and gave me the bad news. Within hours John had found an engine and gave me an estimate. They quickly tore down the engine and within a week I had my car back on the road running better than ever. I have found my new repair shop. Thanks John and your crew, I look forward to many years of having your shop service my vehicles.

reviews.author: Thomas Christopher Calliham
reviews.text: Had an electrical issue with my car. Driving from Tennessee to Charleston. Dash lights on. Hardly ran. Was worried that being from out of state and desperate that I would be taken advantage of. Not the case at all. Had it towed to Carolina and within a few minutes they found a loose connector at the onboard computer. Plugged it in tightly and cleared the trouble codes. As good as new. They could have charged me for a costly repair but all I paid for was the tow and actually received a discount on that. Frank and his crew are a Great bunch of guys. Treated me as if we were lifelong friends, which now we are. Thanks a million. If I lived local I would use them for all my maintenance and repairs

reviews.author: Shalina Grorich
reviews.text: These guys are AMAZING!! John and Milton were able to work on my '88 Mustang and get the old girl running again. We had so much trouble trying to figure out what was wrong with the car but eventually they found the problem and now my car runs better than it has in years! Also, after completing repairs we had to replace the battery and John sent someone out to my house to give me a jump so I could get back to the shop to get the battery replaced. I am so thrilled to have found these guys and I will use them from now on and recommend them to everyone I know.

reviews.author: Tracy Hooper
reviews.text: Excellent service very nice and reasonably priced knowledgeable people had an electrical problem with the AC on my pu 5 other mechanics couldn't figure out they fixed it right away i will definitely be bringing all of my vehicles here. great job guys

reviews.author: Frank Stanley
reviews.text: Unethical and Incompetent!! I own 4 vehicles, prior to today this establishment has worked on 3 of them, and customer and mechanical services were good....until yesterday. I brought one of my vehicles there for a diagnostic, I spoke with one of the managers named John...I've delt with John in the past and had no issues. I asked them to look at the car and call me back with what they discovered and we'll go from there. John told me he'd call in less than two weeks. Three weeks later, I received a call from Frank (one of the owners), and he tells me that he needs $1100 for parts that he purchased for the vehicle, and he needed to calculate labor too, because he had the mechanic install them. When I asked why didn't John call me? Frank replies he's on vacation. I never agreed to moving forward with any services other than diagnostic services. This establishment is attempting to get over on me. They've been in business for over 13 years and aren't accredited by the better business bureau...that resonates with me and it should with others!! I'm escalating this matter with my attorney!!! Save yourself the hastle of bad management and incompetence and shop elsewhere for your vehicle service needs!!!

reviews.author: Alan Smith
reviews.text: I HAVE used them EVER SINCE the day the saved me a TON OF MONEY!!!! Another business was going to rob me blind so glad I got a 2nd opinion and now I use them for everyone of my family vehicles and have referred all my friends and family to use them. Kyle is a fantastic mechanic and highly recommend using CAROLINA AUTO for all your repair and service needs.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.text: Extremely knowledgeable service staff and super personable office staff. Fast quality service with extremely fair prices. Hands down the best garage not only in North Augusta but in all of Aiken County.

reviews.author: Mark T
reviews.text: Beware!!! You might get a good deal as some people say they have or you might get cursed out!! I called and talked to a friendly man on the phone when I called to make an appointment. When I arrive to drop off my car, I am told there is no appointment and that the person who booked the appointment, Frank, does not know what he is doing. And no, they can't promise to work on my car today. When I tell him that I will take my car elsewhere he tells me not to come back. I wonder who p^%&ed in his cornflakes because this was 8am and not once did I raise my voice to him. I am glad that I did not spend any money at this establishment but good luck to you if you chose to do so.

reviews.author: Jeff Hanson
reviews.text: This place has recently taken over the vehicle care for my business. I couldn’t be happier with the top notch customer service, friendly faces, and great value. I recommend these guys for all your auto repair needs.

reviews.author: Scott Prescott
reviews.text: I have taken many cars to Frank over the past 5 or 6 years. Everything from old trucks, nissan Z cars, to my BMW. He always does his honest best to do a good job for his customers. He recognizes that today's cars are very complicated, and sometimes there is not a simple or easy fix. However Carolina Auto repair, under his leadership is a top shelf repair facility, which strives to do the best it can for it's customers

reviews.author: Lovelett Dublin
reviews.text: I have been doing business with this company because of convenience. I had no problems until my first initial visit they stated that if I liked them on Facebook or went on google to I would have a free oil change. The minute I return to get the free oil change they took me through the ringer to get it! Next, on my first initial visit they handed me a loyalty card and stated that after the 4th oil change the next one would be free. Well low and behold after my 4th oil change, returning with my card for the free oil change, I had the same response as the first time! I am not a person that don't give people second chances but this is ridiculous. People ask you to support local businesses but when you do this is what happens. Then they stated that I needed to bring the same car in that I initially brought the first time but no one stated that it had to be a specific car because when they initial the loyalty card it was on different vehicles. What a joke! If you want honest and loyal people you may want to bypass this business. I can not post another review for some reason but you responded to the wrong customer! I was very nice about the hassle of the free oil change. I even waited on the gentlemen to come and pick me up after their mishap on my then 2006 Audi. I am so sorry the this business will not take responsibility for their actions. I was not argumentative even on this vehicle, I just told him that I could use either regular or synthetic oil per dealership not me! I asked to use regular oil from the beginning because it would be on me if anything happened and I was well aware of that. Why it is so hard to do business with (family) who I thought the business represented as such! I will continue to pray for your business.

reviews.author: Ashlee Winter
reviews.text: Just took my jeep there to get my water pump replaced. The shop is very friendly/professional and offered to install it at a great price. Not only was the water pump installed quickly they also test drove it to make sure it didn't still overheat.

reviews.author: Billy Ohara
reviews.text: I brought my Dodge ram pickup to have rear axle and bearings replaced and these guys done a awesom job at a awesome price. I would recommend this place a 5 star service I'm very happy

reviews.author: Todd Anderson
reviews.text: I give Carolina Auto Repair 5 Stars! They have mechanics that I put all trust in. I had them do work on my 2002 Ford Explorer. The C/V Axles were bad, after taking it to 2 other places they either wanted to over charge me or not do it at all. I came to Carolina Auto Repair and they were the most friendliness and reasonable. They did the job the same day. I have since sold my Explorer and bought a new 2016 VW Jetta. I'd rather bring my car here instead of the dealership.

reviews.author: Gerald K Jefferson
reviews.text: He took time to explain everything in great detail about the problems going on with my vehicle. Answered all my questions so i could better understand what is going on. Never pressured me in choosing his shop and he even told me to shop around with other repair shops if i wanted to. Diagnosed my vehicle the same day i had it towed in. Fast service.

reviews.author: Sandra Cain
reviews.text: Kyle fixed my a/c in a day!! I am overjoyed at the service I received at Carolina Auto Repair!! I will be a loyal customer for all my auto repair needs. Kyle is a no nonsense mechanic who knows his stuff!!

reviews.author: David B. Jones
reviews.text: my 1994 toyota truck hasnt run rhis good in a long time after tune up.but it does now .could have charged me for plug wires but knew the ones on there were good..i have sent two other people there and they thanked me for it.

reviews.author: Mr. Muffin Mann
reviews.text: Gee wiz! A mechanic in town with no bad reviews! This is a great place to waste your time and money. If you have an issue with something that requires no mechanical skills or common sense this is the place for you. If you have mechanical issues and need a mechanic.. you will probably be better off taking your car to one of the 16 year olds at a jiffy lube. These guys wasted hundreds of dollars of mine in time and of course in money also. Worst mechanics I've ever had the displeasure of meeting. This company walks the line of being a predatory business. 5 stars for finding ways to snake out of their mistakes and leave you with a bill. 5 stars for review filtering. All crooks smile when they are trying to take you. This place is a 5 star waste of money and time. You will need a 5 star attorney when you are done with these losers.

reviews.author: Christopher Francisco
reviews.text: excellent shop prices are very reasonable they always explain any issues they find with the car and give you plenty of options to work with. very helpful and willing to go the extra mile to fix whats wrong I dont hesitate to bring my vehicles in there for repair.

reviews.author: Scott DuVall Sr
reviews.text: Never take your car here! Consider yourself warned. I complained on the BBB and he as of right now is telling them via email we havent done business together! This guy, Franklin Mishoe, is unprofessional and disrespectful. I live out of town and needed someone to trust to take my mothers car to. They diagnosed her van for a fee and charged us close to $400 for repairs. When my mother picked the vehicle up it was still running hot. She took it back and they charged us another diagnosis fee plus $800 more for what they say are more reasons why it runs hot. The air conditioner was not working the first or second time. I was last told that we need to spend an additional $300 for a radiator because that is Also a problem with it running hot and will need to be done before the problem is fixed. Now we want to pick the vehicle up and they want 4 days storage fees. @ of those days they were closed and the second day my mother went there and they were closed early! When i called Frank to tell him Im unhappy about their businees ways he hung up on me. We are now in the process of filing w the BBB in addition to taking them to Magistrate court if they do not do the right thing. There are many BBB accredited businesses in this area and I would urge you to pick one of those!!!

reviews.author: Tanner Grose
reviews.text: Carolina auto repair is outstanding. I took my Tacoma their to get my belts exchanged and the great people at Carolina Auto Repair took care of my issue cordially and efficiently. They also can handle any towing or motor cycling needs!

reviews.author: Shirley Barnes
reviews.text: Two years ago my car ran hot suddenly. One of my sons recommended Frank Mishoe because he went to school with him and it was close by. Upon talking to him he came to pick up my car and told me it needed something minor at a cost of about 235. I went to pick up the car and almost immediately it ran hot again. This time I drove the car up there. Frank then told me it needed a water pump and timing belt for 1200.After dickering around about not diagnosing this to begin with..we finally agreed to the repairs. About two days later my car broke down on I 20 right at the exit. It was towed to the Kia place where they did some work on it and told me it needed a new motor and I should have been told that by Frank Mishoe. I was able to drive it home where it was picked up by another repair person from Columbia who put in another motor. We did go to court about this. Frank Mishoe misdiagnosed my car problem, then he misdiagnosed it again...total cost to us around 1500 at his shop alone. In going to court with him he came prepared because he is a veteran of the magistrates court. Frank is a soft spoken man and uses his words very carefully to put all the blame on his customer and does not take any responsibility for his malpractice. It was an embarrassing and frustrating event with a local business owner who obviously takes no pride in doing right by his customers. He did not give me a diagnostic sheet with all the things he should have checked but it sure showed up in court. If I had been informed of my options I certainly would not have poured money into a car to repair it when it needed another motor. I am ashamed that someone who lives in my town would stick a customer in the back and then to onto that customers sons business site and post a bad post about this incident when he has never done business with my son. Every person has a right to review a business they have done business with and if that customer is not satisfied they have a perfect right to say so publicly. I am ashamed of Frank Mishoe and his family members who after 2 years have gone onto my sons site again and brought this subject back up again where my sons potential business customers will see it. I am totally disgusted and dismayed that Frank Mishoe would use his children to do his dirty deeds.

reviews.author: Scott DuVall Sr
reviews.text: We have a right to review your business as we have done business w you. You have never done business w mine and we do not have an f rating w the BBB. Anyone reading this can look for themselves. As you can see from other bad reviews how combative they are towards them and take no responsibility for the problem. Our problems were similar to a cpl other customers. They misdiagnosed and fixed things that didn't needs be fixed. They just go in repairing things and charging you for them until they get you out the door with your money. They even went so far as to write a bad review for our family business after we posted our dealings with them on their Facebook page. We have never done business with them with our family business. Very childish and immature for a fiftysomething-year-old man to do.

reviews.author: emily jeffcoat
reviews.text: Southern hospitality with every interaction and very flexible on prices. Management and technicians know their stuff! Highly recommended to the CSRA. Their local towing services are made as convenient as possible too.

reviews.author: grace mcclure
reviews.text: Had a great experience there, The guys were very friendly attended to my vehicle in a timely manner and reasonable price. I was very impressed with the service and will be back soon.

reviews.author: Scotty Latiolais
reviews.text: Reasonable price. There is a drop box with camera you can drop it off the night before. Professional's and will not take advantage of you. Highly recommend it over big garages

IF CAROLINA AUTO REPAIR CAN'T FIX IT IT CAN'T BE FIXED...I WOULD RECCOMEND THIS SHOP TO ANYONE WHO NEEDS VEHICLE REPAIRS ,ONE STOP SHOP,TOP NOTCH. THANK YOU GUYS ,

reviews.author: SANDRA FULTZ
reviews.text: Those guy really take care of my car. They’re quick and my repairs are done correctly. Thanks to the team.

reviews.author: Thadd Chafin
reviews.text: This place is fast, fair and stands behind their work!! Frank and his crew has done all the maintenance on my truck and car and I would highly recommend Carolina Auto to anyone for vehicle maintenance or towing!!

reviews.author: Justin Bailey
reviews.text: Had trouble travling from Florence to AL. Pulled off the interstate and Carolina Auto repair had us fixed and back on the toad in less than an hour. fantastic service and great people

reviews.author: Richard Forcelle
reviews.text: I had to take my car to get fixed due to someone hitting my car and the people there were nice and very knowledgable and the pricing was very reasonable and the the service was fast i was in and out within 40 mins faster than any other place i went to.

reviews.author: Robert Sigwald
reviews.text: Top notch service at a great price every time! I don't even bother asking about prices anymore. I know they will treat my cars like they would thier own.

reviews.author: marshall keller
reviews.text: You got to give this shop a try, unbelievable service, fixed my car and it didn't cost me a arm or a leg. Great prices. Thank you guys for everything. I see why your the best in the CSRA.

reviews.author: Jovohntee Wise
reviews.text: These guys handled my vehicle with courtesy and care and, I would recommend them to anybody and they also do great and wonderful work. I will always take my vehicle to them.

reviews.author: Keith Fields
reviews.text: Not sure what these people are talking about. My husbands truck broke down late one night and I called Frank and one of his people were there in minutes. Very nice and helpful. Thank you Carolina Auto Repair!

reviews.author: Kristi Collins
reviews.text: I had a great experience here and will definitely be going back for most of my car maintenance. Very nice people and fairly priced.

reviews.author: joseph hathcox
reviews.text: They have worked on my ranger and van. Great prices, excellent work! John in the officeis very knowledgeable. Great technicians, they even provide towing.

reviews.author: Ben Mincey
reviews.text: Incredible people! So helpful, and above and beyond a regular auto repair shop. I recommend Carolina Auto above anyone else. Best service ever!

reviews.author: Matthew Wilber
reviews.text: Outstanding service at a reasonable price!! Expected a very costly repair today. Their technician found the problem and fixed it at a fraction of the price. Would recommend to friends and family.

reviews.author: Emily Montgomery
reviews.text: I cant even express how friendly and customer service is... Great dependable and affordable ..Carolina Auto Repair has prompt and a fast turn around for uour auto repair needs..Their mechanics do a awesome job and the Manager John goes beyond his expections to help his customers...I highly recommend Carolina Auto Repair for all your automobiles repair needs..

reviews.author: Kelly Smith
reviews.text: I love the great work the crew did to my truck! They were honest and up front with all issues and gave me a great deal.

reviews.author: Philip Kratzer
reviews.text: My truck has been in the shop for a week and I asked for a quote and they said can't give me one because ncant find the parts and I had to help look for them and his town truck driver had no A/C in the truck on a hot day and waited for.about an he for him also I still haven't got the quote from them and had to ask if they got all the parts in and they said they are and it was on the lift also asked if it be done today and he said don't know when the job only take 6 he by the book to do so I wonder why it will take more then a day to do and why he can't give me an answer so no I will not go back there or recamend them unless you want to help do there job for them

reviews.author: Vernon Abney
reviews.text: John was very nice and gave me a reasonable price for my repairs.My car was ready on time and the AC works great.

reviews.author: Cassandra Fico
reviews.text: Remarkable service and low prices. Frank and sadie are excellent and everything is great quality. Need a repair or a tow? Call Carolina!

reviews.author: Ann
reviews.text: Great service! Had an emergency and they got the car done right away for almost 400.00 cheaper then Pepboys

reviews.author: Jim Arnold

reviews.author: Matt Collier
reviews.text: Carolina Auto repair is a great company and provides excellent customer service, this is my second time going by to get my other car service & I already have a smile on my face.

reviews.author: Jeremy McElhannon
reviews.text: A little slow due to heavy volume, but overall deserving of 5 stars. John wirjed hard to get me a transmission that didn't cost an arm and leg.

reviews.author: Calvin Jackson
reviews.text: They got my car in and out with no problem and they're affordable. I'll be back the next time I need anything done!

reviews.author: Bryant ralls
reviews.text: Had to go thru alot to get my truck back that they towed .... and they would not let me get my stuff out of the truck for work... over all they were pricey.... and unreasonable

reviews.author: Florence Creasy
reviews.text: The best place to take your car.Everyone is nice.listen to you about your car.Ask you questions so they can better service the vehicle.

reviews.author: David Fisher [Student]
reviews.text: We were stuck out of state. Carolina Auto Repair has bent over backwards trying to help us. They even came after hours due to our situation. Thank you Carolina Auto Repair for your help.

reviews.author: Jonathan Kilpatrick
reviews.text: My search for a capable and honest place to take my car has ended with Carolina Auto Repair. Thanks Frank!

reviews.author: Melissa Cottrill
reviews.text: We broke down on vacation & C.A.R.S. saved us! Chris got us in without an appointment, fixed my car & helped us get home safely! Thanks Chris.
